description:
Tafsir on one verse (aya_id OR surah + aya, else BAD_ARG). mode=coverage (default): which tafsir books cover it, fetching no text — shelves 3 (tafsir) and 4 (Qur'anic sciences; not 5, tajwid and qira'at) crossed with Shamela's curated tafsir index, plus index hits from other shelves (in_tafsir_categories:false). Status per book: indexed_covers (with page_id), indexed_no_entry_for_this_aya, or not_indexed_coverage_unknown — NOT evidence the book is silent.
mode=texts: the commentary from several books in one call, each attributed (book, author, death year, printed page), read only from pages the index maps to the verse, never a text-search guess. Each source's `note` names the next call when its text continues. Example: {surah:2, aya:255, book_ids:[1503, 639]}.

aya.description: Verse number within the surah, 1..N; requires `surah`.

aya_id.description: Cumulative verse id, 1..6236 (e.g. 262 = 2:255). Give this OR surah + aya, not both; a reference that disagrees with surah/aya is BAD_ARG.

book_ids.description: Restrict to these tafsir books, read in the order given (omit it and the installed indexed books are read earliest author first). Books not present in the curated index for this aya are reported with an explicit status instead of text. Use shamela_lookup_tafsir(mode='coverage') to see which books the index covers. (mode=texts only.)

downloaded_only.description: If true (default), list only books whose text is installed on this server. false also lists books the curated index maps to this aya whose text is not installed (downloaded:false) — still useful as catalogue references. (mode=coverage only.)

max_sources.description: Maximum number of sources to fetch text for (1-10, default 5). The response-size budget can stop earlier; `remaining_book_ids` lists the sources not read, to pass as book_ids next. (mode=texts only.)

mode.description: Selects what the call does: coverage | texts. Default coverage.

response_format.description: Format of the human-readable text: 'markdown' (default) for display; 'json' the same data as one JSON code block; 'none' only a one-line pointer, leaving structuredContent as the whole answer. structuredContent is always returned, so a caller that parses it should pass 'none': the character budget counts both channels, and the unread copy otherwise spends most of it. Requires the 'response_format.none' capability (see shamela_get_brief).

surah.description: Surah number 1..114; requires `aya`. Alternative to aya_id.

name: shamela_lookup_tafsir

books.description: Every tafsir-shelf book plus index hits, ordered by status, installed first, then book_id; a long list is cut (rows_dropped). (mode=coverage only.)

in_tafsir_categories.description: False for index hits on other shelves: the tafsir shelves crossed here are categories 3 (tafsir) and 4 (Qur'anic sciences).

page_id.description: Commentary page; set only when status is indexed_covers.

status.description: indexed_covers (page_id/printed_page point at the commentary) | indexed_no_entry_for_this_aya | not_indexed_coverage_unknown (absence from the curated index is not evidence the book is silent: many tafsirs carry no per-page aya markers, and on some installs the index holds only al-Tabari; reach it through shamela_read(unit='toc')).

fetched.description: Sources whose text was read. (mode=texts only.)

index_entries.description: Raw index rows; exceeds `total` when commentary spans pages. (mode=coverage only.)

note.description: Caveat: the index is curated, so unknown status is not absence.

remaining_book_ids.description: Indexed sources not read in this call; pass as book_ids to continue. (mode=texts only.)

results.description: The index hits alone, repeating books[] rows; filtered by downloaded_only (false adds hits whose text is not installed, downloaded:false). (mode=coverage only.)

downloaded.description: True when the book's text is installed on this server.

page_id.description: Page the index points to in this book.

sources.description: Read only from pages the curated service/tafseer.db maps to this verse; there is no text-search fallback, which misattributes verses through shared phrases and the basmala. (mode=texts only.)

continued_page_id.description: The page joined onto `text`; a «[— بداية …]» line in `text` marks where it starts.

continued_printed_page.description: Printed page of the joined page — cite this, not `printed_page`, for text after the marker.

foot.description: Footnotes — the editor's words, not the author's.

next_page_id.description: Following page id, to read on with shamela_read(unit='page').

note.description: The exact follow-up call, when one is needed.

status.description: ok | ok_unpaginated | not_indexed | no_entry_for_this_aya | not_downloaded; only ok* carry text.

text_has_more.description: True when the commentary continues past this part; `note` names the exact next call.

verse_located_in_page.description: False when the whole page was returned (with a note) because the verse could not be pinned, e.g. a refrain like «فبأي آلاء ربكما تكذبان» quoted several times on the page with no printed verse number to settle which copy — never a neighbouring verse's commentary instead.

total.description: Distinct books the index maps to this verse, installed or not. (mode=coverage only.)

total_indexed.description: Books the curated index maps to this verse. (mode=texts only.)

totals.description: Count of books in each coverage status. (mode=coverage only.)

title: Tafsir coverage and texts for an ayah
